messages.subject: Re: Problem when deploying the App

I really don't need all the files, just a reproducible example, as small as possible. So if you can post that here, it'd be great. Keeping our discussion here also has the advantage that other people can find the solution by searching online.

There's a chance this is related to this: https://github.com/rstudio/shiny/issues/1671. So, you could try to use the workaround that Winston suggests there and see if it solves it. Basically, change all textOutput()s and corresponding renderText()s into uiOutput()s and corresponding renderUI()s.
